articles.title: Dollar-backed stablecoins can push local currencies lower, Bank of Korea study finds
articles.snippet: Buying pressure in Binance-paired currencies correlates with local currency depreciation as market makers balance positions.

articles.title: SoFi, Kraken tie up as crypto and banking push into each other's turf
articles.snippet: Kraken is joining SoFi's settlement network and list SoFiUSD as the companies link traditional banking with crypto markets.

articles.title: Poland upholds crypto bill veto as Zondacrypto scandal widens
articles.snippet: Polish lawmakers failed to overturn a presidential veto of crypto legislation as the Zondacrypto investigation expands and its Estonian operator enters bankruptcy.

articles.title: Bitcoin reclaims $80K as DXY falls amid continuing suspected yen intervention
articles.snippet: Bitcoin rallied 5% to reclaim $80,000 as the US dollar weakened amid a suspected Bank of Japan currency intervention, though analysts remain split on the impact.

articles.title: Kraken parent Payward partners with SoFi on stablecoin, 24/7 settlement
articles.snippet: The deal will bring SoFiUSD to Kraken, connect Payward to SoFi’s 24/7 dollar settlement network and give SoFi access to digital asset liquidity through Kraken Prime.
